- When an agent starts after a fresh clone or a pull that introduces tracker files, startup shall detect and complete missing local setup before implementation.
- When local setup, runtime prerequisites or vault access cannot be established, harness and agent startup shall refuse implementation and name the required action.
- When bootstrap runs again, it shall preserve repository history and unrelated user configuration without repeating repository migration.
- When used standalone or with the harness, bootstrap shall retain user installation as the default and support the existing portable runtime paths.
payload.description:
## Context

The owner requires repository-owned onboarding for persistent agent memory.
One person configures the repository and commits all required shared setup.
Other machines receive the instructions, skills and bootstrap through clone or pull.
Agents must establish tracker context before implementation. Missing memory must stop work.
Related feature: basicly-gtb19bg.43.

## Scope

Detect missing machine setup from committed repository guidance and executable startup paths.
Configure the existing tracker without repeating repository migration.
Cover standalone and harness entrypoints. Preserve unrelated settings and frozen history.
Stop with a named remedy when prerequisites, permissions or vault access prevent setup.
Do not claim arbitrary third-party agents are blocked without an actual enforcement path.

## Confirmation Plan

Use public installer and agent-start regressions with fresh homes and repository copies.
Exercise clone, pull introduction, successful bootstrap, repeated startup and unavailable context.
Run affected standalone, agent installation, hook and consumer checks.
Keep existing gates and original concurrency tests unchanged.

payload.text: Candidate 5e539b5c is pushed in PR 6. Its quality run 43752880790 reported 9463 passed and one failed distinct-record burst. Outcomes were 48 landed and four unsettled. Platform compatibility and projection checks passed. The source-bound loaded comparison passed, but does not override failed CI. Two later throughput experiments were rejected after original burst failures. Evidence is preserved. Local inverse commit f038dbca restores the exact 5e539b5c tree. No release or live switch occurred. The remaining repair must preserve original outcomes, deadlines and gates.

The owner reviewed the refreshed development cutover runbook at 19:38 UTC on 2026-11-15 and directed us to proceed when all conditions pass. Fresh exact-source rehearsal on 5e539b5c passed all four parts with 61 records and 497 source events. The installed standalone proof preserved all five source files and all carried history bytes. Its scratch usage exported 62 records and 522 events. Linux and native Windows old-tool matrices passed 37 and 27 rows. Native MCP, admission, identity and push-protection proofs passed on the same wheel. Ordinary and squash code-branch merge proofs passed with no tracker changes in code trees. Full quality CI still failed the distinct burst, so release remains blocked. The owner now also requires committed cross-machine startup bootstrap under basicly-f0voo8o.

Owner clarification applies to the full basicly harness and its standalone tools. Initial repository onboarding must commit the shared instructions, skills and bootstrap. Clone and pull must bring enough setup for agents on other machines. Require Python 3.14 or later. Provision through uv or uvx. Never use Python venv creation. Do not begin implementation without persistent tracker context. This record is assigned to codex-2 for independent work while codex-1 repairs claim concurrency.

verified 2026-11-15 against https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/tools/ and https://docs.astral.sh/uv/guides/install-python/ (uv 0.13.7 plus installed --help): uv tool run/uvx isolate tools from the project; --python selects runtime and uv provisions missing Python. User clarification accepts uv-managed isolation and forbids explicit Python venv creation. Implementation boundary: mandatory repository-bound memory bootstrap before managed agent/harness execution; no blanket online gate on offline tracker writes, no implicit new local ledger, no unrelated user configuration replacement. Runtime inventory: four standalone distributions still declare >=3.9; engine already >=3.14. Three tests explicitly use Python venv and require uv equivalents under changed contract.

Concurrency checkpoint 2026-11-15. Source 67f2db16 adds strict completed-peer-head reuse on urgent retry. Source de8dc77d rejects unusable coverage before Git queries. Public witness, busy-lock, missing-ref and repeated-rejection controls pass. Normal staged, commit and push gates pass. Metadata merge 12f83700 has the identical tracker tree and is pushed in PR 6. The unchanged four-CPU workload passed all eight tests in 96.55 seconds. Both burst cases returned correct outcomes below their original deadline. Saved remote snapshots contain 52 unique events and each successful event exactly once. Both thousand-event controls passed. The stronger two-CPU diagnostic still failed its scaled 3.75-second real-load deadline and is retained without a passing claim. New quality run 43761296472 is active. No release acceptance, main source landing or live switch is claimed.

Owner condition added before live migration. Audit each repository story for actionable context, testable acceptance criteria, distinct validation requirements and planned criterion-to-command evidence. Refine incomplete active stories before implementation. Preserve custom attributes, reviews, confirmations, dependencies and historical events. The current payload and migration controls passed 35 tests. Six custom-template controls passed, including independent import/export with valid process evidence. These checks establish storage and validation capabilities, not semantic completeness of every story. Perform the content audit before each live migration in development, basicly, handily and terminal. Record fresh source digests and rehearsal counts after content refinement. Unexpected count differences retain the existing owner stop condition. Initial onboarding must commit shared setup under basicly-f0voo8o; later clone or pull must establish machine context automatically. The full harness and standalone tools require Python 3.14 or later with uv provisioning. Use existing --port 0 mode for local UI startup.
